name: mumbai-erp
description: Mumbai ERP — food manufacturing & franchise management: production, inventory, transfers, franchise ordering, billing, payments, expenses, POS, analytics, and Tally Prime accounting sync.

scripts.dev: npm run db:up && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run api:dev" "npm run web:dev"
